title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.07525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. translated_title: 面向多模态大语言模型的统一幻觉模糊测试
translated_abstract: 幻觉仍然是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）面临的一个持续性挑战，严重限制了其在高风险应用中的可靠性。现有评估主要基于静态基准测试，存在分类覆盖面窄和性能快速饱和的问题，无法反映模型在不断演变的真实场景中的鲁棒性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个将综合基准与自演化压力测试相结合的系统性评估框架。首先，我们介绍了UniHall，这是一个基于统一分类体系构建的细粒度数据集，涵盖对象、指令和知识三个维度。其次，为解决基准饱和问题，我们提出了自适应多模态模糊测试（SAMF），这是一个采用进化变异策略来探索模型幻觉边界的自适应框架。至关重要的是，为确保对动态输入的可靠评估，SAMF 引入了结构化的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了结合统一幻觉分类细粒度数据集UniHall与自适应多模态模糊测试SAMF的系统性评估框架，利用进化变异策略动态探索多模态大语言模型的幻觉边界，克服了传统静态基准覆盖面窄和性能饱和的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic evaluation framework combining UniHall, a fine-grained benchmark grounded in a unified taxonomy of Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions, with Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), which employs evolutionary mutation strategies to dynamically probe the hallucination boundaries of MLLMs, addressing the narrow coverage and performance saturation of static benchmarks.
